expression_sql: COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE opened_date = metric_date) AS total_incidents_opened
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_date = metric_date) AS total_incidents_resolved
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE closed_date = metric_date) AS total_incidents_closed
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 1 AND opened_date = metric_date) AS critical_incidents_opened
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 2 AND opened_date = metric_date) AS high_incidents_opened
AVG(time_to_resolve_hours) AS avg_time_to_resolve_hours
PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_resolve_hours) AS p50_time_to_resolve_hours
PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY time_to_resolve_hours) AS p95_time_to_resolve_hours
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE made_sla = true AND resolved_date = metric_date) AS sla_met_count
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE made_sla = false AND resolved_date = metric_date) AS sla_missed_count
ROUND(sla_met_count * 100.0 / NULLIF(sla_met_count + sla_missed_count, 0), 2) AS sla_compliance_rate
AVG(reassignment_count) AS avg_reassignments
AVG(reopen_count) AS avg_reopens

description: Aggregate incidents by category and month
expression_sql: COUNT(*) AS total_incidents GROUP BY category, subcategory, DATE_TRUNC('month', opened_date)
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 1) AS critical_incidents
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 2) AS high_incidents
COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY period_month) AS category_share_pct

description: Aggregate by assignment group and month
expression_sql: COUNT(*) AS total_assigned GROUP BY assignment_group_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', opened_date)
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE resolved_at IS NOT NULL) AS total_resolved
ROUND(total_resolved * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_assigned, 0), 2) AS resolution_rate

description: Count open incidents by priority per snapshot date
expression_sql: COUNT(*) AS open_incidents WHERE state NOT IN (6, 7) GROUP BY snapshot_date, priority
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATEDIFF(snapshot_date, opened_date) > 7) AS aged_7_days
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATEDIFF(snapshot_date, opened_date) > 14) AS aged_14_days
COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE DATEDIFF(snapshot_date, opened_date) > 30) AS aged_30_days

description: Calculate average age of open incidents
expression_sql: AVG(DATEDIFF(snapshot_date, opened_date)) AS avg_age_days
COUNT(*) AS total_opened GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', opened_date)
COUNT(*) AS total_closed GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('week', closed_date)
total_opened - total_closed AS net_change
ROUND((total_opened - LAG(total_opened) OVER (ORDER BY week_start_date)) * 100.0 / NULLIF(LAG(total_opened) OVER (ORDER BY week_start_date), 0), 2) AS week_over_week_opened_pct
